purpose: Qualify a causal 1-minute chronological zipper trajectory from available historical start through the pre-FINAL boundary with path-dependent account state, halt-style internal-gap semantics, and time-serial/batch-parallel execution.

trajectory_semantics.chronology: strictly increasing; no random clip reset in status-driving long-trajectory experiments
trajectory_semantics.state_recurrence: Account[t+1] is produced only after Action[t] is frozen and transition t->t+1 is realized
trajectory_semantics.checkpoint_restart: must restore exact terminal account/runtime state; restart-from-default is forbidden

internal_gap_halt_model.scope: internal gaps bracketed by two observed 1-minute records for the same listed asset
internal_gap_halt_model.scientific_interpretation: simulation convention analogous to a trading halt; not a factual claim that the exchange price truly remained constant
internal_gap_halt_model.price_source: last observed close strictly before the gap
internal_gap_halt_model.forbidden_price_source: first post-gap/reopening price or any later payload
internal_gap_halt_model.reopening: first observed post-gap minute remains untouched and may jump
internal_gap_halt_model.audit_flag: halt_imputed; audit/provenance only and forbidden as an extra Student feature
internal_gap_halt_model.forced_exit_during_halt: FORBIDDEN until a halt-compatible Physics adapter is parity-qualified
internal_gap_halt_model.funding: only archived funding observations may be applied; no synthetic funding

causal_firewall.decision_indexing: observation at decision t may contain only market data with timestamp <= t and Account[t] computed from the prefix ending before transition t->t+1

vectorization_contract.time_axis: causal scan; inherently sequential for one path-dependent account
parallel_axes: assets at the same UTC clock
counterfactual action branches for target-side evidence
vectorization_contract.market_encoding: compute once per (asset,timestamp) and broadcast across account/action replicas where semantics permit
vectorization_contract.physics_reference: existing FrozenTradingKernel is scalar authority; any batched Physics adapter must prove parity against it before scientific use
vectorization_contract.training: stored causal evidence may be minibatched on GPU; minibatch order is not trajectory order
vectorization_contract.required_parity: batched environment result must equal scalar reference account-by-account for identical inputs

learning_semantics.r11_teacher: allowed only through current probabilistic/cross-fit authority or a separately preregistered experimental objective
